items.headline: Hyperliquid Whale's $ETH Long Wiped Out Completely
items.summary: A Hyperliquid whale's 56,667-$ETH long was fully liquidated, leaving the tracked accounts with lifetime losses near $44.8M after earlier trimming from 93,184 ETH.

items.headline: $ZEC Explained: How Shielded Transactions Work
items.summary: With $ZEC back in the spotlight after its Nu7 upgrade, this breakdown explains how zk-SNARK shielded transactions hide sender, recipient and amount on Zcash.

items.headline: Toss Won Stablecoin Pilot Picks $OP Stack
items.summary: Korean super-app Toss will run a won stablecoin pilot on $OP Stack, making it the fourth regulated financial institution in a year to choose Optimism's stack.

items.headline: Anchorpoint to Issue HKDAP Natively on $SOL
items.summary: Anchorpoint plans to issue its HKDAP token natively on Solana, adding to the chain's growing roster of tokenized fiat and payment assets. $SOL keeps attracting issuers.

items.headline: BIP-110 $BTC Fork Dies as Only Miner Quits
items.summary: The BIP-110 $BTC breakaway fork stalled at two blocks after its sole miner OCEAN pulled hashrate, refunding about 0.3 BTC after roughly 18 hours of mining.
